notes.title: SUGOI!!
notes.notes:
From the terrific creators of the awesome [url=https://tgagwcaga.com/]TGAGWCAGA [/url](The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards), here comes the [b]SUGOI showcase[/b], and here we are!!! 🎉

If it wasn't in your vocabulary so far, "SUGOI" comes from Japanese and means amazing, wonderful, great, fantastic. Now that you know that, you can only imagine how cool the selection is! 🔥

You will have [b]from March 27 to April 3[/b] to take a look at the line up of more than 30 incredible games the SUGOI team picked out 👀
Additionally, they are treating us with a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cud7vqpdEoA]livestream[/url] to provide everyone with an entertaining overview!👌

Hope you enjoy, and if you have time, show some love to all the creators with a wishlist!❤️

notes.title: Tom the postgirl: Watch the devs play!
notes.notes:
[h3]Event Information[/h3]
We're part of the AdventureX Sales Event from Nov. 4 - Nov. 11. We'll run multiple events and announce them here. Apologies if you see several announcements.

[h3]About Tom the Postgirl[/h3]
This spooky adventure follows the mischevious Tom on her deliveries which surprisingly always go wrong. No wonder, she is a real stalker and peeks inside whenever she gets the occasion to. Go along with her and see what the locals may have to hide.

notes.title: Day of the devs X Tom the postgirl
notes.notes:
Dear all,

We are excited to announce that we'll be part of the [i]Day of the Devs Summer Game Fest Edition's showcase[/i], highlighting upcoming indie games! ✨

The initial broadcast takes place LIVE on [b]YouTube Theater[/b]🎥 
[i]⏱️Friday, June 7, directly following SGF Live, around 4am PT[/i]
So don't miss out on the presentation of their crazy line-up!

For the occasion, we'll put our demo back online and leave it for the duration of the Summer Game Fest. 
(and probably some more time after that 😇)

See you soooon 👀

notes.title: FAQ on the balcony
notes.notes:
With the temperatures rising, we decided to take the stream on the balcony in order to go through some questions.
We hope you enjoy this little sunbath while we feed you with some crispy fun facts!

notes.title: Fun facts with the devs, watch us play!
notes.notes:
As part of our participation in the LudoNarraCon, we sit down together to play through our demo which is available online for the very first time! While playing, we will share fun facts about in-game elements as well as exchange about our experience developing it.

This is our very first time recording ourselves in a stream setting, so please bear with us as we try to figure it out :$

See you at the stream!

notes.title: Tom the postgirl is part of LudoNarraCon 2024!
notes.notes:
Short but exciting news, we're part of this year's Official Selection of the LudoNarraCon's narrative games festival, kicking off on May 9! For the occasion, we have a couple things brewing.

1. A demo will be released shortly so all of you can finally get a feel of stalking. The final game is still very much a Work in Progress, but we are happy to give you access to this first edition!

2. Two livestreams will be happening, one commented play-through as well as a chill FAQ session. Keep an eye out for these!

You can find the whole line-up of amazing games and speakers at this address: [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/]LudoNarraCon24[/url]
And you can sign up to the event's newsletter if you don't want to miss a single beat:
[url=http://bit.ly/FellowTravellerNewsletter]LNC Newsletter[/url]

Of course, please don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!
See you very soon :)

The Oopsie Daisies
